tasks.short: Recommend fuel suited to a site

steps.what: Assess site circumstances and specify feasible fuels, demand and comparison assumptions
Calculate comparable fuel cost and performance measures from the specified scenarios
Check calculations and recommend the fuel best suited to the site's circumstances

tasks.design: Configure checked comparison formulas in {SPREADSHEET} from an engineer-authored site and fuel specification. Calculations produce measures rather than a best-fuel decision; the engineer checks assumptions and recommends an option.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparable fuel scenarios required repeated calculation setup and tabulation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tables and formulas can recalculate a specified set of scenarios deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Fuel suitability, uncertain supply and site constraints require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognizes when the lowest calculated cost conflicts with practical requirements.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic leaves fuel selection judgement and investment rights unchanged.
